subject.title: Feature request: Auto-send intent/acknowledgment text message before agent processing

question: Should OpenClaw add a supported cross-channel text acknowledgement before agent processing, and if so should it be a `messages.ackText` config surface or a non-terminal send-and-continue plugin/channel hook?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the fix adds new visible channel behavior and config/API surface while overlapping Telegram, Slack, Discord, and reaction-based presence work.

options.title: Sponsor A Cross-Channel Ack Text Contract
options.body: Add a default-off `messages.ackText` or equivalent send-and-continue contract with scopes and per-channel/account overrides, then update schemas, docs, channel behavior, and tests together.

options.title: Let Channels Own Placeholder UX
options.body: Keep this broad issue as product context while Slack, Telegram, Discord, Feishu, and other plugins implement default-off placeholder lifecycles with channel-specific semantics.

options.title: Decline Text Acks For Now
options.body: Rely on typing indicators, ack reactions, status reactions, and progress drafts, and close or narrow the related placeholder requests accordingly.

recommendation.title: Sponsor A Cross-Channel Ack Text Contract
recommendation.body: Add a default-off `messages.ackText` or equivalent send-and-continue contract with scopes and per-channel/account overrides, then update schemas, docs, channel behavior, and tests together.

likelyOwner.reason: Prior review and adjacent reply-lifecycle history make steipete the strongest owner for the cross-channel UX/config boundary choice.
